items.excerpt: How agentic interfaces are changing what designers control: the agentic canvas now pulls context from across tools into one place and acts on it without step-by-step instructions.
The question isn't whether AI reduces work, but where the intellectual work moves -- an argument that reading and writing are themselves interfaces AI can now smooth out.

Minority Report gave interaction designers two futures for gestural, predictive computing -- two decades later, this piece argues the industry rebuilt only the easy-to-demo one, not the cautionary one.
ArtStation is moving to act against AI-generated art on its platform, but critics say the policy dodges the harder question of how it will actually be enforced for working artists.

Meet Lamp, an "alive" Pixar-like desk robot with character design and embodied AI that watches posture, remembers faces, and answers emails -- raising the question of whether this is the future of embodied assistants.

At IFA 2026, NVIDIA highlighted local AI tools including CyberLink PhotoDirector's AI PC Mode, which runs generative editing, background replacement, and portrait refinement locally on RTX Spark hardware without cloud token limits.
In this episode of The Unlock, illustrator Carly Berry uses Generative Recolor in Adobe Illustrator to experiment and find her iconic color palettes.
Adobe demos Dynamic Text in Photoshop, which automatically adjusts placed text layers' space and structure as content changes, built from customer feedback.
As AI-generated writing floods LinkedIn, Substack, and even medical papers, a new crop of tools promises to help writers find and fix the AI "tells" in their own style and workflow.
